test_title: PYST 7 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct one-word substitute for:**

The art of beautiful handwriting.
solution: The correct answer is: **Calligraphy**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Calligraphy"** refers to the art of beautiful handwriting, often created using special pens or brushes. (सुंदर लिखावट की कला) • **Example: **She practiced calligraphy every day to perfect her skills for creating elegant wedding invitations. • **Calligraphy** is a specialized skill that involves creating visually appealing text and is often used in decorative designs or artistic expressions. (सुंदर अक्षर लिखने की कला) • **Example: **The museum displayed ancient calligraphy scrolls that showcased beautiful script styles. • Hence, we can conclude that the art of beautiful handwriting is known as **"Calligraphy"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Calligraphy**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Orthography** (वर्तनी): The conventional spelling system of a language. • **Example: **The English orthography can be challenging for non-native speakers due to its irregularities. • **Lexicography** (शब्दकोश निर्माण): The practice of compiling dictionaries. • **Example: **He studied lexicography to understand how dictionaries are made. • **Etymology** (शब्दों की उत्पत्ति का अध्ययन): The study of the origin and history of words. • **Example: **Learning the etymology of a word can help you remember its meaning and origin. 41:Ta04, The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Corrupt)**.
